name: 3D printers
description: Progress, time left, temperatures, filament and a camera picture for Bambu Lab printers in Home Assistant (the ha-bambulab integration).

options.label: Printer
options.help: The printers are the Bambu Lab ones Home Assistant has. A printer's name comes from Home Assistant (its Printer name sensor).

choices.label: Only busy printers: printing, paused, or failed in the last few minutes (empty when none are)

options.label: Minutes a failed print counts as busy
options.help: A Bambu printer keeps saying Failed until the next print starts. After this long it counts as idle again, so with Only busy printers it drops off and a split screen gets its space back. 0 drops it straight away.

choices.label: Camera while printing, the model picture otherwise

options.label: Show the filament in the AMS
Home Assistant address (blank uses the one on the Settings page)
Access token (blank uses the one on the Settings page)
